rationale: theme-management.spec.js covers theme toggle/persistence and predefined themes but never asserts the token layer itself: token resolution, light->dark value flip, OButton token-class + data-o2-variant hooks, or OTable/OSelect token chrome + slug matrix. This cross-cutting design-system migration (area GeneralTests) needs its own dedicated spec. No existing spec touches these runtime facts, so action is 'new' (not extend/append). Register the new file in ci_matrix.json GeneralTests run_files (the single source of truth for the playwright matrix).
